provider_receipt.summary: Read-only review completed; the parent clean-tree receipt is digest-identified and reports exit code 0, and this node made no modifications. Named defects: (1) src/policy.rs:89 checks trace requirements only for metadata.requires_review, while src/policy.rs:129 can independently require review for critical risk; therefore a critical non-mutating tool with requires_review=false can reach review_required without a trace even when require_trace_for_review=true. (2) src/policy.rs:160 implements target patterns as raw string-prefix matching, so path-like targets such as scope/../secret satisfy scope/* unless a downstream runtime separately canonicalizes and revalidates them. (3) src/receipt.rs:20 and src/policy.rs:186 produce receipts without invocation_id, tool_id, target, caller, requested_at_utc, or an input digest, so a receipt is not cryptographically or structurally bound to the invocation it purportedly authorizes and can be misassociated or replayed by downstream systems. (4) src/types.rs:69 treats requested_at_utc as any nonblank string and performs no timestamp parsing, freshness, or replay validation despite describing the input as a UTC request time. Existing tests cover only basic allow, missing mutation trace, and explicit critical review paths, leaving these cases unverified.
